name: GetSourceKind
source: lane AD: the check-tree runner (0x451f00) tests the whole result against 1 to fill the second word of the tree arguments

name: GetStackObject
source: lane AD: looks the word at +0xe up in the object table (0x450f10); the check-tree trace logs its id and name as 'Stack Object'

name: GetActor
source: lane AD: looks the word at +0xc up in the object table and asks it for interface 0x5a69d3d5 (0x450e70), the Sim's cITSPerson (the one opcode 0x0d calls its 'caller interface')

name: GetInteractionId
source: lane AD: the index at +0x14 (the position in the stack object's interaction list); negative means none (0x451f00 returns early); Person Data 0x15, 0x2d, 0x4c, 0x4d, 0x66 receive it

name: GetPriority
source: lane AD: goes to Person Data 0x21, which opcode 0x0d reads as the priority

name: GetTableEntry
source: lane AD: slot 87 of the stack object (its interaction list), element at +0x14 (0x450f90)

name: Initialize
source: lane AD: called when slot 29 says no, right after Person Data 0x27 is cleared (0x5205c0, 0x520360)

name: IsInitialized
source: lane AD: see Initialize

name: SetCheckPending
source: lane AD: sets bit 2 of the flag dword at +0x68 (0x451b10); the check-tree runner sets it to 1 first

name: HasPassedCheck
source: lane AD: bit 3 of the flag dword at +0x68, which slot 40 sets; the person primitives reject an interaction when it is clear after the check

name: SetCheckPassed
source: lane AD: sets bit 3 of the flag dword at +0x68 (0x451ab0); only the low byte of the argument is read. The check-tree runner clears it first and finally sets the verdict (the dword it passes also carries the upper bytes of its first stack argument)

name: SetBranchFlag
source: lane AD: sets bit 5 of the flag dword at +0x68 (0x451c40); 0x520360 passes the tree sim's last-branch byte (cTSTreeSim slot 29) to the interaction it replaces

name: SetOwnerPerson
source: lane AD: takes the cITSPerson subobject (this + 0x2f0) of the person that queued the interaction, or null; 0x512c30 hands it to every queued entry

name: CheckAllowed
source: lane AD: 0x451f00 calls it with 1 when the actor's slot 30 says yes and ANDs the answer in

name: IsSimOnly
source: lane AD: 0x520360 stores it in Person Data 0xa4

name: GetAllowedAgeMask
source: lane AD: ANDed with the actor's age mask (cITSPerson slot 52) in the check-tree runner

name: IsInitialized
source: lane AD: 0x5205c0 and 0x523da0's callers clear the person's motive vector when it is set

name: IsRestricted
source: lane AD: in the check-tree runner it vetoes the interaction when tuning 0x23 is set

name: IsDebugOnly
source: lane AD named it IsAutonomousOnly (it vetoes the interaction in the check-tree runner); lane AH: cTSTreeTableEntry slot 39 is bit 7 of the entry flags. The runner only lets such an entry through on a debug-flagged stack object (0x2000) while the debug setting is on, and the gathers skip it (0x44fbc0, the autonomy gather, never lists it), so it marks entries that exist for the debug menu

name: GetCheckTreeId
source: lane AD: the tree id the check-tree runner executes (0 skips the run)

name: GetPersonData
source: lane AD: Person Data field read (cTSPersonITS slot 10); flag is always 1 here

name: SetPersonData
source: lane AD: Person Data field write; flag is always 1 here

name: GetCurrentInteraction
source: lane AD: returns the person's field at +0x5bc (0x518d80)

name: GetSelectedInteraction
source: lane AD: returns the person's field at +0x5c4 (0x518da0)

name: GetAttribute
source: lane AD: object attribute read (0x52f900: 0x72 words at +0xa6); out of range gives 0

name: SetAttribute
source: lane AD: object attribute write; the check-tree runner clears attributes 6, 0x32, 0x65, 0x68 of the actor first

name: GetObjectId
source: lane AD: the word at +0x1cc (0x52fbe0); every caller zero-extends it

name: GetTreeOwner
source: lane AD: CallTree's owner argument in the check-tree runner (0x52f0e0 forwards to the object at +0x240)

name: GetName
source: lane AD: the string the check-tree trace logs as 'Stack Object Name'

name: TestFlags
source: lane AD: the check-tree runner asks for 0x2000

name: NotifyObjectEvent
source: lane AD: ret 0x14 (0x53d340); a person that rejects an interaction raises kind 4 with its own object id on the stack object

name: GetAttributeTable
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 reads a flag word from it (slot 3)

name: GetUseCounters
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 keeps a per-Sim use counter in it

name: GetFlags
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 tests bit 0 of index 0x19

name: GetColumnCount
source: lane AD: 0x523da0; a row with 2 or more columns is initialised

name: CreateRow
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 creates the row with 2 columns

name: GetCell
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 reads column 1 (the use counter)

name: SetCell
source: lane AD: 0x523da0 writes column 1

name: IsUseTracked
source: lane AD: gates the use counter of 0x523da0

name: GetSimRow
source: lane AD: Person Data 0x1f (cTSPersonITS slot 57); 0x523da0 uses it as the row of the use-counter table

name: GetSimObject
source: lane AD: the cTSObject of the Sim (its tree arguments are saved and restored around a check tree)

name: GetTreeSim
source: lane AD: the tree sim that runs the check tree (slot 15 CallTree)

name: GetLifeStage
source: lane AD: 0x51aa60: slot 19's value, 0 when it is 14

name: GetAgeMask
source: lane AD: 0x517f70: one bit per life stage (0x10000, 0x200, 0x10, 0x800, ...)

name: GetObjectKey
source: lane AD: 0x1413e0, the value the test sim stores in its field +0xc

name: GetOwnerId
source: lane AD: compared between the actor's object and the stack object by the check-tree runner

name: RecordTableEntry
source: lane AD: the holder's slot 63 object (0x451f00's third argument); told which table entry is being checked

name: GetCounterRecord
source: lane AD: ret 0x10; the record's words +6 and +8 are reset or negated by the check-tree runner
